title: Days Elapsed for a Missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit
content:
## Billing calendar table — Specimen Collection Appointments

The days elapsed for a missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit are counted in calendar days up to today. Where the count starts depends on when the no-show fee was posted — the date of the assessed no-show fee line on the missed visit's fee record — compared with the missed appointment date on the visit record.

| No-show fee posted (calendar days after the missed appointment date) | Days elapsed |
|---|---|
| More than 7 days after | Counted from the date the no-show fee was posted to today |
| 4 to 7 days after | Counted from the missed appointment date to today, less the days of posting delay beyond 3 |
| Within 3 days | Counted from the missed appointment date to today |

**Clause.** When the no-show fee was posted more than 7 days after the missed appointment date, the count starts on the date the no-show fee was posted; when it was posted 4 to 7 days after the missed appointment date, the count starts on the missed appointment date and the days of posting delay beyond 3 are taken off; when it was posted within 3 days of the missed appointment date, the count starts on the missed appointment date.

### Cases (hypothetical: missed appointment on day A, today is day A plus 15)

| Fee posted on | Delay | Days elapsed |
|---|---|---|
| Day A plus 1 | 1 | 15 |
| Day A plus 3 | 3 | 15 |
| Day A plus 4 | 4 | 15 less 1, that is 14 |
| Day A plus 7 | 7 | 15 less 4, that is 11 |
| Day A plus 8 | 8 | From day A plus 8 to day A plus 15, that is 7 |
